meta.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 countries, point of view NLD
meta.pov_note: Internationally recognised borders (Dutch and EU position): Crimea is part of Ukraine, Northern Cyprus part of Cyprus, Aland part of Finland.
meta.clip: Rings are clipped to bounds. Vertices on lat 34, lat 72, lon -25 or lon 45 are clip edges, not coast or border; countries cut this way carry clipped:true.
meta.ring_format: countries[].polygons is a list of outer rings, clockwise, closed, no holes. A country may have several rings (islands, exclaves). Enclaves such as San Marino overlap the ring of the surrounding country.
meta.codes: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3. XKX (Kosovo) is user-assigned, not an ISO code. part_of names the sovereign state of a dependency (JEY, GGY, IMN, FRO, GRL).
meta.markers: Entries with marker:true (VAT) are enlarged stand-ins for a country too small to draw or hit at map scale.
meta.rivers_lakes: Carried over unchanged from the previous data/map_eu.json; their source was not recorded.
